name: Select / Team Filter
description: Team Filter product scenario for the Select component.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disable focus, interaction and native form submission.

controls.name: name
controls.description: Native form key; multiple values produce repeated entries.

controls.name: form
controls.description: Associate this field with a form by id.

controls.name: aria-label
controls.description: Accessible field name when a visible label is not appropriate.

controls.name: options
controls.description: Available choices, with unique values.

controls.name: placeholder
controls.description: Hint shown when no value or display override is present.

controls.name: label
controls.description: Visible field label; native aria-label/aria-labelledby override its accessible name.

controls.name: labelOrientation
controls.description: Label placement. Has no effect without a label.

controls.name: displayValue
controls.description: Replace selected labels in the trigger, for example with a count or icon.

controls.name: iconOnly
controls.description: A square trigger without a chevron. Supply an accessible field name.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Fill the available inline width. Defaults to true.

controls.name: stretchText
controls.description: Expand the value area and align the chevron to the inline end.

controls.name: required
controls.description: Require at least one selection for native form validation.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Controlled popup visibility. Disabled/empty lists cannot be opened.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Uncontrolled initial popup visibility.

controls.name: surface
controls.description: Auto uses a sheet on compact viewports; side is a hover/click inspector picker.

controls.name: surfaceBreakpoint
controls.description: Viewport breakpoint used only by surface="auto".

controls.name: surfaceTitle
controls.description: Mobile sheet heading. Falls back to the field label or accessible name.

controls.name: closeLabel
controls.description: Accessible name for the sheet close button.

controls.name: contentMinWidth
controls.description: Minimum popover width, capped by the viewport. Does not resize side/sheet surfaces.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Shared membrane around the trigger and option geometry.

controls.name: multiple
controls.description: Select one option.

controls.name: value
controls.description: Selected option, or null for no selection.

controls.name: defaultValue
controls.description: Initial selection, restored on form reset.
